professionalSummary.text: Revenue management data scientist with experience building nightly room-demand forecasts and price-elasticity models for 42 mid-market hotels at Brightwater Hotels since March 2022.
professionalSummary.witness: Revenue management data scientist at Brightwater Hotels (42 mid-market hotels), March 2022 to present, building nightly room-demand forecasts and price-elasticity estimates by hotel and booking window.

experienceHighlights.text: Presented monthly pricing recommendations at commercial reviews attended by the commercial director and regional general managers, maintaining an action log of adopted and deferred recommendations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented the monthly pricing recommendations at the commercial review attended by the commercial director and the regional general managers, and kept the action log showing which recommendations were adopted.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained the daily extract from the property management system into the warehouse with row-count and late-arrival checks that alert the data engineering rota.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the daily extract from the property management system into the warehouse, with row-count and late-arrival checks that alert the data engineering rota.

experienceHighlights.text: Evaluated the 2023 weekend minimum-stay test against six matched control hotels using a difference-in-differences comparison over twelve weeks.
experienceHighlights.witness: Evaluated the 2023 weekend minimum-stay test against six matched control hotels using a difference-in-differences comparison over twelve weeks.

experienceHighlights.text: Produced a four-page guide to the pricing dashboard for revenue managers, explaining forecast bands and the recommended-rate column, and posted it on the commercial team's intranet page.
experienceHighlights.witness: Produced a four-page guide to the pricing dashboard for revenue managers, explaining the forecast bands and the recommended-rate column, and posted it on the commercial team's intranet page.
